The '''Shadow Syndicate safe house''' was located on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], within [[Keeling]]'s listening post, and used by the [[Shadow Syndicate/Legends|Shadow Syndicate]].  It served as [[Maro Vizhen]]'s undercover facility, using the front of the listening post to keep themselves and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire's]] intentions hidden.

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the syndicate was confronted in the safe house by [[Ukabi]] and his men.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shadow Syndicate safe house appears as an area on Nar Shaddaa in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="SWTOR" />
